newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 20.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping died yesterday at the age of 92. President Jiang Zemin to succeed him.
-- European defence-sector industrialists fear consequences of a French defence electronics industrial grouping called for by the government around a privatised Thomson-CSF.

-- CDR structure in charge of sellling off Credit Lyonnais assets renounces a 235-million-franc claim held by Lyonnais subsidiary SDBO on ski resort "Isola 2000" -- under creditor protection -- in order to ease a takeover by leisure group Pierre et Vacances.

-- Renault to post 1996 losses estimated at around three billion francs, analysts expect difficult times ahead for the French carmaker due to intense competition on the European market and insufficient cost-cutting.
-- Arms manufacturer Giat Industries lost 1.3 billion francs in 1996 according to union sources.
-- Air Inter Europe to maintain some 63 percent of its flights today in spite of surprise strike by three pilots' unions.
